=== Header ===
Derived mechanically from the ORM model by `gnd extract` (R-08").
Constraint-blind by specification: object types, reference schemes,
fact-type readings and primitive shapes only — no constraint
sentences, no modality, no provenance. Hand-authoring this file is
banned; regenerate it with `gnd extract MODEL --out DIR`.

=== Object Types ===
Person is identified by PersonId.
PersonId is a value of type Integer.
Room is identified by RoomCode.
RoomCode is a value of type String.
Course is identified by CourseCode.
CourseCode is a value of type String.
Seats is a value of type Integer.
Booking is identified by the combination of person (in fact type booking_by_person) and room (in fact type booking_of_room).
